articles.title: Lavushimanda vaccinates 7,013 domestic animals against anthrax
articles.description: The Department of Fisheries and Livestock in Lavushimanda District, Muchinga Province has vaccinated 7,013 domestic animals against anthrax in the district. Livestock Production and Extension Officer Godfrey Singoyi said this is out of a total target of 9000 animals to be vaccinated against Anthrax this quarter representing 96.91 percent of the vaccination coverage.
